message.realscale.lotm.guide: This release supports Sequence 9 and Sequence 8 across four pathways. Explore matching biomes for occult creatures, plants and crystals; rare materials and sealed characteristics may appear in vanilla structure chests. Use the Occult Alchemical Apparatus with a recipe and Spirit Ember to brew potions. Exploration, skill use and research reward digestion. Commands: /lotm acting, /lotm skills, /lotm status, /lotm materials and /lotm config. Sequence 7 is archived.

message.realscale.lotm.skills.seer.9: Seer (Sequence 9): sense occult creature variants; use the pendulum to detect nearby occult ores and plants.
message.realscale.lotm.skills.seer.8: Clown (Sequence 8): improved coordination and brief slow falling when focusing.
message.realscale.lotm.skills.mystery_pr: Mystery Pryer (Sequence 9): use a focus to scan nearby occult minerals, plants and sealed loot traces in vanilla structures.
Melee Scholar (Sequence 8): brief movement-speed boost when focusing.
Sleepless (Sequence 9): night vision and mobility at night; senses nearby hostile creatures.
Midnight Poet (Sequence 8): improved brief recovery and slows nearby hostile creatures when focusing.
message.realscale.lotm.skills.corpse_col: Corpse Collector (Sequence 9): senses nearby undead and resists freezing.
Gravedigger (Sequence 8): weakens nearby undead and gains brief recovery when focusing.
message.realscale.lotm.skills.archived: Sequence 7 is archived; its advancement and abilities are disabled in this release.
